research_royalties.reason: New: the canonical per-tag income program, "raise your credit income by 1 per Science tag on your cards" (production_per_tag, counted once, counting itself). Needs 3 Science. Integration: 10 credits, the one price of the six per-tag programs (one shape for one job).
research_royalties.value: Pay 10 + 2.5 + 2.5 = 15. At 4 Science tags (the least it sees) 16 + 1 = +2; at 6, 24 + 1 = +10; at 8, +18. Researcher, rounds 3-5.

ransomware_syndicate.reason: New: Cyber's per-tag income program, +1 credit income per Cyber tag. Needs 3 Cyber. Integration: 10 credits (one price for the six).
ransomware_syndicate.value: Pay 10 + 2.5 + 2.5 = 15. At 4 Cyber tags 16 + 1 = +2; at 6, +10. A Cyber-heavy seat, rounds 3-6.

economies_of_scale.reason: New: Industry's per-tag income program, +1 credit income per Industry tag. Needs 3 Industry. Integration: 10 credits, insight 1.
economies_of_scale.value: Pay 10 + 2.5 + 2.5 = 15. At 4 Industry tags (the Builder's printed tag counts for needs only) 16 + 1 = +2; at 6, +10. Builder, rounds 3-5.

capacity_market.reason: New: Power's per-tag income program, +1 credit income per Power tag. Needs 3 Power. Integration: 10 credits.
capacity_market.value: Pay 10 + 2.5 + 2.5 = 15. At 4 Power tags 16 + 1 = +2; at 6, +10. A Power seat, rounds 3-6.

peace_dividend.reason: Reworked (was sway 2 for 5, a trivial card): Diplomacy's per-tag income program, +1 credit income per Diplomacy tag. Needs 3 Diplomacy. Integration: 10 credits.
peace_dividend.value: Pay 10 + 2.5 + 2.5 = 15. At 4 Diplomacy tags 16 + 1 = +2; at 6, +10. Protector, rounds 3-6.

defense_appropriations.reason: New: Security's per-tag income program, +1 credit income per Security tag. Needs 3 Security. 10 credits.
defense_appropriations.value: Pay 10 + 2.5 + 2.5 = 15. At 4 Security tags 16 + 1 = +2; at 6, +10. Protector, rounds 3-6.

cryptojacking_campaign.reason: New: Cyber's big income program. Integration: it printed the same "+8 credit income" as University Spinout and Multiyear Defense Budget, so it now burns energy for more: pay 2 energy, raise your credit income by 9, 18 credits.
cryptojacking_campaign.value: Pay 18 + 9 (energy) + 2.5 + 2.5 = 32. Get 36 + 1 = +5. A Cyber seat with spare energy, rounds 2-4.

multiyear_defense_budget.reason: New: Security's big income program. Integration: varied from the two other "+8 credit income" cards: +6 credit income and +1 energy income, 30 credits.

singularity_exploit.reason: Antimatter ultimate, needs 3 Cyber. Card fit: the proposal's drain-all 12 line set at 5.8 pt, so it keeps r41's "remove a botnet in reach, discard an adversary project" and drops to 4 credits.
singularity_exploit.value: Pay 4 + 7 (antimatter) + 5 + 6.5 = 22.5. Get 12 + 8 + 1 = 21: -1.5 at the table's 7 an antimatter, +2.5 at the 3 the heuristic holds it at. Cyber seat, late.

peacekeeper_rotation.reason: A troop feeder that still moves an ambassador (was 3 ambassadors for 3). Card fit: "5 ambassadors or 2 troops" set at 5.8 pt, so it removes 2 troops from a hex in reach, the kind Security Contractor HQ pays for.
peacekeeper_rotation.value: Pay 12 + 2.5 + 2.5 = 17. Get 22 (2 troops in reach) + 1.5 + 1.5 = 25 (+8), plus 20 with Security Contractor HQ. Protector.

agency_field_station.reason: The tier-1 Security trigger. Card fit: the proposal's Agents counter ("add 1 Agent per Security card; at 3, remove 2 troops in one country") set at 5.4-5.8 pt, so it pays directly: when you play a Security card, remove 1 troop in one country. Agents stay on Agency Directorate and Intrusion Lab.
agency_field_station.value: Pay 10 + 2.5 + 2.5 = 15. A Security seat plays about 1 Security card a round: 1 troop in a country (7) a round over 4 rounds = 28 + 1 (+14), and each troop fires Security Contractor HQ (10). Protector, from round 2.
agency_field_station.loop: Troop removal pays credits through HQ; credits buy cards, capped by the hand, insight and troops on the board.

open_assembly.reason: The Followers counter: when you play a Diplomacy card, add 1 Follower here; at 3, sway 3 toward Unity. Card fit: printed as a Diplomacy card, not per Diplomacy tag (same play, shorter line).
open_assembly.value: See the Diplomacy row: about 1 Diplomacy card a round, 3 Sway (12) every 3 rounds. Protector.
open_assembly.loop: Followers to Sway; Sway places no tokens.

botnet_takedown.reason: Restored at integration as r41 printed it: the Cyber and Science designs cut Botnet Takedown and Breakthrough Lab, leaving two of r41's four botnet removers (Singularity Exploit, Root Access); that changes the adversary's counterplay, not the engines, so one comes back.
botnet_takedown.value: Unchanged from r41: pay 8 + 5 + 6.5 = 19.5, get a botnet (12) and 8 compute (8.8) + 1.5 = 22.3.

synthetic_data_forge.reason: Restored at integration as r41 printed it: with Exabyte Archive cut, Telemetry Archive was the only Dataset holder, so Dataset Scraper and Data Licensing Deal were dead without it.
synthetic_data_forge.loop: Datasets to insight; insight places no tokens.

consular_pouch.reason: Was a flat 3 ambassadors, near-trivial: now the one-off per-tag payout, gain 1 ambassador per Diplomacy tag on your cards (it counts itself). Integration: needs 2 Diplomacy, since a program whose only effect is a per-tag gain is refused with none of the tag already in play (feasible.rs), though it would count itself.
consular_pouch.value: Pay 9 + 2.5 + 2.5 = 14. Get 4 a tag: at 3 tags (the least it sees, itself included) 12 + 1, at 4 tags 17 (+3), at 6 tags 25 (+11). Protector, rounds 4-8.
